external_entities.name: Customer
external_entities.description: A customer who signs in and loads the web application.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers sign in to our Auth0 identity provider

external_entities.name: Auth0 identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used for customer authentication and OAuth2 bearer tokens.

external_entities.name: Stripe
external_entities.description: External payment service used for payment authorisation.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Payment authorisation goes to Stripe over HTTPS with a secret API key

external_entities.name: Support administrator
external_entities.description: A staff administrator using the admin console to manage orders.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Support administrators are staff who use an admin console

external_entities.name: Analytics team
external_entities.description: A group of internal analysts that queries the analytics bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The analytics team, a group of internal analysts

external_entities.name: Platform team
external_entities.description: The team permitted to copy or restore database snapshots and S3 objects, and read audit logs.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore its snapshots

processes.name: CloudFront
processes.description: Serves the React single-page web app to the public internet and applies the stated WAF request limit.
processes.source_excerpt: CloudFront serves it to the public internet over HTTPS with TLS 1.3

processes.name: React single-page web app
processes.description: The customer-facing web application that calls the Orders API.
processes.source_excerpt: The web app calls an internal Orders API in our AWS VPC over HTTPS

processes.name: Orders API
processes.description: The API that handles customer orders and support administration actions.
processes.source_excerpt: The Orders API reads and writes a Postgres database

processes.name: AWS WAF
processes.description: Limits each client to 2,000 requests per five minutes on CloudFront.
processes.source_excerpt: AWS WAF on CloudFront limits each client to 2,000 requests per five minutes

processes.name: Nightly batch job
processes.description: A nightly job that reads at most one day of orders and writes summaries to S3.
processes.source_excerpt: A nightly batch job in the same VPC reads at most one day of orders

processes.name: Athena
processes.description: The query service used by the analytics team to query the S3 bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The analytics team, a group of internal analysts, query that bucket through Athena over HTTPS

data_stores.name: Postgres database
data_stores.description: Database containing customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It holds customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history

data_stores.name: CloudWatch Logs audit log
data_stores.description: KMS-encrypted audit log containing each action written by the Orders API.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Customer signs in to Auth0 using a password and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers sign in to our Auth0 identity provider over HTTPS with TLS 1.3, using a password and MFA.

data_flows.name: load app
data_flows.description: Customer loads the React single-page web app from CloudFront.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Anyone can load our React single-page web app without signing in; CloudFront serves it to the public internet

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The web app calls the Orders API with an Auth0 OAuth2 bearer token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every call carries an Auth0 OAuth2 bearer token; the API rejects unauthenticated requests

data_flows.name: access orders
data_flows.description: Orders API reads and writes the Postgres database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The Orders API reads and writes a Postgres database in a private subnet over TLS, with IAM database authentication.
data_flows.data_description: Customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history

data_flows.name: authorize payment
data_flows.description: Orders API sends payment authorisation to Stripe using a secret API key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Payment authorisation goes to Stripe over HTTPS with a secret API key
data_flows.data_description: Payment authorisation; card numbers never reach our systems

data_flows.name: read orders
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job reads at most one day of orders using a read-only database role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads at most one day of orders over TLS with a read-only database role
data_flows.data_description: At most one day of orders

data_flows.name: write summaries
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job writes summaries to the S3 bucket using its IAM role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes summaries over HTTPS, with its own IAM role, to a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket

data_flows.name: query bucket
data_flows.description: Analytics team queries the S3 bucket through Athena with read-only IAM roles.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The analytics team, a group of internal analysts, query that bucket through Athena over HTTPS with read-only IAM roles.

data_flows.name: read summaries
data_flows.description: Athena reads summaries from the S3 bucket for analytics queries.

data_flows.name: manage orders
data_flows.description: Support administrator uses the admin console to refund orders, edit delivery addresses, and look up order history.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Through it they refund orders, edit delivery addresses, and look up order history.
data_flows.data_description: Refunds, delivery addresses, and order history

data_flows.name: write audit action
data_flows.description: Orders API writes each support action to the CloudWatch Logs audit log using its IAM role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API writes each action over HTTPS, with its IAM role

data_flows.name: copy or restore snapshots
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores database snapshots.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore its snapshots.

data_flows.name: copy or restore objects
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores S3 objects.
data_flows.source_excerpt: only the platform team can copy or restore its objects

data_flows.name: read audit log
data_flows.description: Platform team reads the CloudWatch Logs audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: only the platform team can read
